push.title: Push notifications
push.subtitle: Get told on this device when something becomes yours, even when OpsTrack is closed.
push.explainBody: Your browser will ask for permission once. Nothing is sent until you allow it, and you can turn it off here at any time.
push.explainAssigned: You'll get one notification when an item is assigned to you.
push.explainCompleted: And one when an item you raised is completed.
push.explainPrivacy: A notification carries the item's title and who acted — the same line the inbox shows. Nothing else leaves the app.
push.enabled: Push notifications are on for this device.
push.disabled: Push notifications are off for this device.
push.kindsHint: These apply to every device. The inbox keeps everything either way.
push.kindCompletedHint: An item I raised is done.
push.masterHint: Mute every device without unregistering them.
push.devicesHint: Each browser registers separately, including the installed app.
push.removeBody: It stops receiving push notifications. Nothing else changes, and the inbox is unaffected.
push.iosTitle: Add OpsTrack to your Home Screen first
push.iosBody: On iPhone and iPad, Safari only allows push notifications for an app installed to the Home Screen. It takes three taps and everything else keeps working exactly as it does now.
push.iosStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari.
push.iosStep3: Open OpsTrack from the Home Screen and come back to this screen.
push.blockedTitle: Notifications are blocked for this site
push.blockedBody: The browser is refusing them, so OpsTrack cannot ask again. Allow notifications for this site in your browser's settings, then reload this page.
push.unsupportedTitle: This browser can't receive push notifications
push.unsupportedBody: Nothing is missing from the app itself — only the part that reaches you when OpsTrack is closed.
push.inboxNote: The notification inbox works everywhere, with or without push.
push.errDenied: The browser refused notifications. Allow them for this site in your browser's settings, then try again.
push.errDismissed: The permission request was dismissed. Try again when you're ready.
push.errSubscribe: This browser couldn't register for push notifications. Reload the page and try again.
